# 定语从句

- 基本概念
  - 修饰名词或代词的从句
  - 先行词：被修饰的词 ^antecedent
  - 关系词：引导从句，并在从句中充当成分
- 关系代词 ^pronoun
  - who：指人，作主语/宾语
    - The man who lives next door is a doctor.
  - whom：指人，作宾语
    - The girl whom I met is Lucy.
  - whose：表所属，人或物
    - I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
  - which：指物，作主语/宾语
    - This is the book which I bought.
  - that：指人或物 🟠 ^that
    - The car that he drives is new.
  - 作宾语时可省略
    - The book (that) I read was boring.
- 关系副词 ^adverb
  - when：时间，= in/on which
    - I remember the day when we met.
  - where：地点，= in/at which
    - This is the house where I was born.
  - why：原因，= for which
    - That's the reason why he left.
- 限制性与非限制性 ^restrict
  - 限制性：无逗号，不可省
    - Students who work hard will pass.
  - 非限制性：有逗号，补充说明 🔵
    - My father, who is 50, loves tennis.
  - 非限制性不能用 that 🔴 ^no-that
  - as / which 引导整句
    - As we know, the earth is round.
- 易错点 🔴 <!-- fold -->
  - 只用 that 不用 which ^only-that
    - 先行词为 all、everything、nothing 等
      - All that he said is true.
    - 先行词有最高级、序数词修饰
      - It's the best film that I've seen.
    - 先行词既有人又有物
  - 介词 + 关系代词：只能 which/whom
    - The pen with which I write is red.
  - 关系副词 vs 关系代词：看从句缺不缺成分
    - This is the place (which) I visited.
    - This is the place where I live.
  - 先行词是 way：用 that / in which / 省略
    - I like the way (that) she talks.
  - 主谓一致：看先行词的单复数
    - He is one of the students who are good at English.

%%
that -.->|限制| no-that
that -.->|特殊情况| only-that
adverb -->|可替换为介词+which| pronoun
no-that -->|区别| restrict
%%
